english.title: Wore / carried etc an article supporting proscribed organisation - terrorism
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), in a public place, namely **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..),

(A)_[wore an article, namely **(..SPECIFY DETAILS..),]_
(B)_[carried an article, namely **(..SPECIFY DETAILS..),]_
(C)_[displayed an article, namely **(..SPECIFY DETAILS..),]_

in such a way or in such circumstances as to arouse reasonable suspicion that you were a member or supporter of a proscribed organisation, namely **(..SPECIFY ORGANISATION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 13(1)(b) and (3) of the Terrorism Act 2000.

english.notes:
(i) The consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions or the Attorney General is required, section 117 of the Terrorism Act 2000.
(ii) See Schedule 2 for a list of proscribed organisations.
(iii) This offence applies to acts done outside the United Kingdom regardless of the nationality of the offender, see section 17.
(iv) For UK-wide jurisdiction for this offence regardless of where it took place see section 28 of the Counter-Terrorism Act 2008.
(v) See also the offences of wearing item of clothing in a public place in section 13(1)(a) and of wearing/displaying and article/item of clothing on relevant premises in sections 13(1ZA) (H102801).

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 6 months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

For offences committed on or after 12th March 2015 the fine on summary conviction is unlimited, see section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012.
